units: <cite ref="Shabbat 77b:7">Sabb. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ לעקרב</he> (Ms. O. <cite ref="U00001"><he>ש׳</he></cite>) a (crushed) spider is a remedy for a scorpion’s bite; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:2:5">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᶜ</cite> bot. Sabb. l. c. <he>אימת ס׳ על וכ׳</he> the fear which the scorpion has of the spider; Yalk. Am. 544 <cite ref="U00001"><he>ש׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 103b">Snh. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>העלה ס׳ ע״ג וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="U00001"><he>ש׳</he></cite>) caused spider-web to cover the altar.—Pl. <he>סְמָמִיּוֹת</he>.
Sifré Deut. 354 ס׳ מכישות אותו וכ׳ (not סמומ׳) spiders bite him, and he dies &c.; Yalk. ib. 961.—[LXX a. Vulg. translate שממית spotted lizard, v. next w.]
